    elapsed_idx = names.index("elapsed_days")

        hr = values[:, hr_idx]

            day ** 2,

    trend_x, trend_numeric = build_trend_inputs(x)
    trend_xp, _ = build_trend_inputs(xp)

    trend = HistGradientBoostingRegressor(
